headline: true
question_wording: Cu ce candidat veți vota pentru funcția de Președinte al României pe 18 mai 2025?
notes: Media-only poll (ADR-0012 Q-B): CURS published it through TVR Info, not on curs.ro. The shares and the question are read from the CURS slide in the article (curs-doc-010, the article's featured image; double entry, two independent passes). Fieldwork (8–11 May 2025), sample size, mode, margin of error and weighting are from the TVR Info article (curs-doc-009, https://tvrinfo.ro/noul-sondaj-curs-george-simion-52-nicusor-dan-48-inaintea-turului-doi-al-alegerilor-prezidentiale/): 'realizat telefonic (CATI) pe un eșantion probabilist, multistadial și stratificat de 3042 de respondenți adulți, reprezentativ la nivel național'; 'Marja de eroare este de ±1,8% la un nivel de încredere de 95%'; 'Datele au fost ponderate în funcție de votul exprimat în primul tur'. published_date is the article's declared publication time (2025-05-13T12:19:23+03:00); a second media report (Adevărul, same day) is listed in the inventory. The article says 'reprezentativ la nivel național' without saying whether the diaspora is covered, so population_geo is empty. No client is stated in the slide or the article, and the question type is not stated. The share base is not stated; the two shares sum to 100 with no undecided option, so they are recorded as expressed_option. The article's other six slides (subgroup breakdowns and a side question) and its AtlasIntel item are not recorded.
